faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.subtitle: Everything you need to know about IFZA Setup Packages. Still have questions? We're one message away.

items.a: IFZA (International Free Zone Authority) is one of the most flexible and affordable Free Zones in Dubai, known for low-cost setup, 100% foreign ownership, and quick licensing — typically within 3-7 working days.

items.q: What is included in the IFZA setup package?
items.a: Depending on the package, you get the Free Zone license, residency visa, medical & Emirates ID, lease agreement, bank account assistance, premium Dubai address, and free VAT consultation.

items.q: How much does an IFZA package cost?
items.a: Our IFZA packages start from AED 5,999 (Economy) and go up to AED 16,999 (Mainland + Residency). Premium packages with visa start at AED 14,499.
Typically 3-7 working days for license issuance, and additional 1-2 weeks for visa processing and bank account opening.
Yes. All packages are starting points and can be customized to match your business activity, visa needs, and budget.

items.q: Do I get a UAE residency visa?
items.a: Yes, select packages include a UAE investor/residency visa with medical, Emirates ID, and status change. The Free Zone License with Lifetime UAE Residency even offers lifetime residency.
Yes. All packages include free assistance with corporate bank account opening at top UAE banks.

items.q: What business activities can I do?
items.a: IFZA supports over 1,000 business activities — trading, professional services, e-commerce, IT, media, education, and more. Pick up to 5 activities in most economy packages.

items.q: Do I need to be physically present?
items.a: Most steps can be done remotely, but medical tests and Emirates ID biometrics require a brief visit to the UAE.

items.q: Why choose Setup Zone Dubai for IFZA setup?
items.a: We offer transparent pricing, fast processing, dedicated consultants, and end-to-end support — from license to visa to bank account. All with 10,000+ successful setups.
